$description: Canonical, machine-readable index over every approved token in tokens/00-foundation, tokens/10-semantic, tokens/20-component, tokens/30-layout, and tokens/themes -- one authoritative catalog so a generator never has to infer across files. Indexes real keys; does not duplicate values. extraction/verify_all.py's token-catalog-parity check resolves every entry here against its real source file.
resolutionOrder: themes/light (the only theme -- resolves each semantic role to a concrete foundation value)
10-semantic (role names a generator should reference, e.g. text.primary)

theme.$description: The only theme this project ships (see registry.manifest.json for the single-theme note). Resolves each 10-semantic role to a concrete 00-foundation value.

button.$description: Component-scoped approved token applications -- the only approved way to style buttons; a generator must not introduce raw values here.
